Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs
Sponsor: Whitt
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 156 as introduced authorizes the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources to issue multiple new disabled U.S. military veterans appreciation resident lifetime hunting, freshwater fishing, saltwater fishing, and combination licenses with fees ranging from $25 to $60, as shown below, dependent on the age of the applicant, the level of disability of the applicant and the type of license purchased. This bill also provides that these fees may be adjusted periodically based on the percentage increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI), as is currently provided by law for certain other hunting and fishing licenses.
This bill would increase receipts to the Alabama Game and Fish Endowment Fund and the Marine Resources Endowment Fund, while correspondingly decreasing receipts to the Game and Fish Fund and the Marine Resources Fund, by an undetermined amount dependent on the number of licenses purchased and the amount of the license, as provided below:

Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
Sponsor: Beasley
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 45 as passed the Senate allows the Secretary of State to conduct a post-election audit of the November 8, 2022 election in three counties, which could increase the obligations of the Secretary of State and the judges of probate and sheriffs of these select counties by an estimated maximum of $30,000 collectively according to the Secretary of State. However, this bill provides that the expenses of these local offices would be reimbursed from federal funds. According to the Secretary of State, the local offices and the Secretary's office would be reimbursed from Help America Vote Act funds.
Bob Fincher, Chair
Constitution, Campaigns and Elections
